_comment: Optional per-model metadata. Keys are .glb file names without extension. 'scale' is the default scale applied so the model has a realistic size in meters; 'description' tells the agent what the model is. Models without an entry still show up (scale 1, name as description).

building-small-a.description: red brick two-storey townhouse, flat roof, door on front

building-small-b.description: green three-storey apartment building with roof antenna

building-small-d.description: grey corner shop with green awning over the front

building-garage.description: grey single-storey garage with an orange door

grass-trees.description: square grass tile with a cluster of small pine trees (mini forest)

grass-trees-tall.description: square grass tile with a cluster of taller pine trees (mini forest)

pavement-fountain.description: square grey paved plaza tile with a fountain in the middle

platform.description: dark stone platform slab with yellow trim, jumpable

platform-medium.description: medium dark stone platform slab with yellow trim, jumpable

platform-large.description: large dark stone platform slab with yellow trim, jumpable

coin.description: gold coin collectible, looks best floating ~1m above ground

flag.description: purple flag on a pole (goal flag)

wall-high.description: tall red brick wall segment with stone cap

wall-low.description: low red brick wall segment, can be jumped over

banner.description: standing purple banner on a pole

block.description: low sandstone block/step, can be stepped on

bricks.description: small pile of loose bricks, rubble

stairs.description: sandstone staircase; at rotation 0 you walk up it heading north (the steps face south)

statue.description: stone knight statue on a sandstone pedestal

wall-corner.description: grey stone castle wall corner piece (L-shaped)

wall-gate.description: grey stone castle wall with an arched wooden gate

weapon-rack.description: weapon rack with swords and spears
